description: Synthetic same notice_id/URL returns DIFFERENT bytes at two retrieval times (silent server-side replacement). Exercises append-only capture: a new revision must be created, old bytes retained, never overwritten.
expected_contract_outcome: Adapter must create a new revision (v2) and retain v1 bytes. Overwriting v1 with v2 is a contract violation. If only the latest bytes exist and v1 was never captured, revision_history must be marked PARTIAL and intraday replay for the changed window fails closed.
warnings: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_ONLY: not real data; sha256 values are placeholders.
Silent raw-byte replacement is a normal A-share risk (Agent A audit 5.8); capture must be append-only.
